title: Customers without activity
brief: Keep customers who have no activity.
instructions: Return every customer and the count of all their orders. A customer without orders has count zero.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes customer_id,customer_name from customers without solving customers without activity.

hints.text: A left join preserves customers with no match.
Group by customer identity and count the optional order identity.
COUNT(*) would give the orderless customer 10001 a false count of one.

dataClaims.sql: SELECT count(*)::VARCHAR FROM customers c WHERE c.customer_id = 10001 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id)
